# GSAP runtime files

`gsap.min.js` and `MorphSVGPlugin.min.js` are the unmodified `dist/` files from the official `gsap@3.15.0` npm package (`https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz`). Their copyright and licence notices remain in the files.

This is a custom licence, not MIT or another SPDX open source licence. The licence text is copied from [GSAP's official page](https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/) because the npm archive has no `LICENSE` file.
